status: 텃새 10만 마리 이상 · 나그네새 수천 마리

months.note: 전국에 사는 텃새로 사철 볼 수 있고, 1년에 2회 정도 번식한다.

summary: 도시 공원에서 산지 숲까지 어디서나 흔히 보이는 우리나라의 대표적인 비둘기다. 머리와 몸 아랫면은 회갈색이고, 날개깃 가장자리가 적갈색이어서 접은 날개가 비늘처럼 얼룩져 보인다. 작은 나뭇가지를 엉성하게 쌓은 둥지에 알 2개를 낳으며, 1년에 두 번쯤 번식한다. 낮고 탁한 소리로 '구, 구, 쿠-, 쿠-' 하고 울며, 번식기에는 날개를 수평으로 편 채 활공하기도 한다.

points.en: scaly wing coverts with rufous fringes
pale band at tip of dark tail

young: 어린새는 어른보다 칙칙하고, 특히 머리 색이 흐리며 목 옆의 줄무늬 반점이 없다.

similar.how: 몸이 더 연한 회갈색이고, 목 옆 줄무늬 대신 뒷목에 흰 테를 두른 검은 반달 목테가 있다. 국내에서는 드물다.
야생형 깃은 연회색 바탕에 날개의 검은 띠 두 줄과 흰 허리가 특징이며, 집비둘기는 깃 색이 개체마다 크게 다르다.

art.subject: Oriental Turtle Dove (Streptopelia orientalis), adult (sexes alike, plumage the same all year): forehead and crown bluish-grey; rest of the head, neck and breast pinkish grey-brown; on each side of the neck a patch of four or five black bars edged blue-grey; mantle brownish grey; scapulars, tertials and wing coverts with large blackish centres and broad rufous fringes, forming a bold scaly pattern; lower back and rump bluish-grey; primaries blackish; belly paler buffy grey, vent and undertail coverts grey; tail blackish with a blue-grey band across the tip, grey rather than white; small dark grey bill; orange-red eye; reddish-pink legs and feet.
art.pose: Perched on a bare branch in three-quarter side view, wings folded so the scaly pattern and neck patch are clear.
art.scene: The edge of a Korean mixed pine and oak woodland bordering dry crop fields in early spring (March): leafless oak branches, green pine needles, pale brown fields and a grassy bank below, soft morning light. No people, buildings or text.
views: adult, perched on a branch, side view: bluish-grey crown, pinkish grey-brown head and breast, black-and-blue-grey barred patch on the neck side, black-centred rufous-fringed scaly wing coverts, dark tail with a grey tip, orange-red eye, reddish legs

adult in flight seen from directly above, head pointing straight forward in line with the body, tail fanned: scaly rufous-fringed wing coverts, bluish-grey lower back and rump, blackish primaries, dark tail with a blue-grey (not white) band at the tip
juvenile, perched on a branch, side view: duller and browner overall, plainer greyish-brown head, no barred neck patch, paler and narrower fringes on the wing coverts
art.build: Bulky, deep-chested dove, about 33cm: about the size of a feral pigeon but with a smaller head and a longer tail. Rounded head, short neck. Bill short and slender, much shorter than the head. Legs short, reddish-pink. Wings fairly long and pointed. Tail fairly long and rounded at the tip, blackish with a blue-grey terminal band (not white) that shows best when fanned. Flight fast and direct; in display it glides with the wings held flat and the tail spread.
avoid: Do not paint a black half-collar on the hindneck; that is Eurasian Collared Dove.
Do not paint a white rump or two black wing bars on pale grey wings; that is the feral pigeon.
Do not paint the neck patch as white spots or a plain black patch; it is a set of black bars edged blue-grey.
Do not paint a white tail tip or a white vent; in the Korean birds both are grey.
